title: notification-05: Reload Config Producer
summary: Primo producer reale: reload config success/failure con Retry.
description: reload_config -> Result, notifica di successo, notifica di errore sticky con NotificationAction Retry, log su stderr, dedup degli errori ripetuti.
goals: reload_config diventa result-aware e produce un toast di successo o un errore sticky con azione Retry, senza perdere la config corrente su un fallimento.
dependencies: Aspetta l'azione notify/NotificationDraft (P055/P061, gia scritte) e il mount (P060) per essere visibile a schermo.

tasks.title: Ensure runtime reload applies notification_system
tasks.description:
`prefix+Shift+r` deve aggiornare `notification_system` runtime senza restart e senza cache divergenti.

---
**Completion summary:**
SHIPPED earlier this session (commit bfabbb7), verified still in place after the P062 reload_config refactor:
- reload_config (heca/src/main.rs) calls state.notifications.set_auto_dismiss(Duration::from_millis(settings.notification_system.auto_dismiss_ms)) and set_mode(settings.notification_system.mode) on every prefix+Shift+r.
- set_auto_dismiss / set_mode are pub(crate) on NotificationRuntime; auto_dismiss applies to notifications raised afterwards, mode gates raise() (mode="none" → suppressed()).
- Test set_auto_dismiss_affects_only_notifications_raised_afterwards + mode_none_suppresses_and_mode_change_is_live cover the live behaviour.

VERIFICATION: ./scripts/lint-changed.sh test + ./scripts/lint-changed.sh exit 0; heca notification tests 64/64. Not driven by Antonio.
FILES: heca/src/main.rs, heca/src/notification.rs.

tasks.title: Refactor reload_config to return Result
tasks.description:
Rendere `HecaApp::reload_config` result-aware senza perdere la safe behavior: su failure mantenere config corrente e non nascondere errori.

---
**Completion summary:**
SHIPPED: HecaApp::reload_config (heca/src/main.rs) now returns Result<(), heca_config::loader::ConfigError> instead of () — Err carries the parse/load error; Ok(()) on the happy path. The failure arm still early-returns before touching self.app_config (the working config is preserved on a bad file — unchanged behaviour) and keeps its two eprintln! lines (T218). The `if let Some(ref mut state) = self.state` wrapper became `let Some(state) = self.state.as_mut() else { return Ok(()); }` + a plain block (body indentation kept, to hold the diff to the signature and the error path). Caller in about_to_wait matches on the result (see T216/T217).

VERIFICATION: ./scripts/lint-changed.sh test + ./scripts/lint-changed.sh exit 0; heca + heca-config clippy-clean. Not driven by Antonio.
FILES: heca/src/main.rs.

tasks.title: Emit reload success notification
tasks.description:
Dopo reload riuscito, emettere success toast auto-dismiss con dedup `config.reload.success`.

---
**Completion summary:**
SHIPPED: on a successful reload, about_to_wait (heca/src/main.rs) raises `Notification::success("Configuration reloaded").dedup_key("config-reload").send()`. Auto-dismisses at [settings.notification_system] auto_dismiss_ms. The dedup_key is shared with the failure toast (T217) so a fixed-then-reloaded config replaces its own error toast in place (update_duplicate recomputes expires_at from the new draft, so the replacement success toast starts its own auto-dismiss timer).

VERIFICATION: compiles; both lint gates exit 0. Not visually verified — Antonio drives: press prefix+Shift+r on a good config, see the toast, watch it auto-dismiss.
FILES: heca/src/main.rs.

tasks.title: Emit reload failure notification with Retry action
tasks.description:
Su failure, emettere sticky danger toast con body errore, dedup `config.reload.failed` e azione Retry → `WmAction::ReloadConfig`.

---
**Completion summary:**
SHIPPED: on a failed reload, about_to_wait raises:
`Notification::danger("Config reload failed").body(e.to_string()).dedup_key("config-reload").action(NotificationAction::new("Retry", Intent::new("reload_config"))).sticky().send()`
- .sticky() — a broken config needs the user to act, so it does NOT auto-dismiss (opt-in per T503's rule; needed a new `Notification::sticky()` builder method — added, delegates to NotificationDraft::sticky(), test notification_sticky_opts_out_of_auto_dismiss_and_survives_the_runtime_rewrite proves next_expiry() stays None after the runtime's with_auto_duration rewrite).
- Retry action: `reload_config` is an existing catalogued Global action (heca/src/actions.rs:1429, WmAction::ReloadConfig), so the button re-runs it via handle_reload_config → pending_reload → next about_to_wait retries and re-notifies.
- body carries e.to_string() — ConfigError implements Display (already used by the eprintln!).
- dedup_key "config-reload": a repeated failed reload updates the toast in place; a subsequent success replaces it.

VERIFICATION: compiles; both lint gates exit 0; notification tests 64/64. Not visually verified — Antonio drives: break config.toml, prefix+Shift+r, see the sticky error toast with the parse message + Retry, fix it, click Retry, watch it flip to the success toast.
FILES: heca/src/main.rs, heca/src/notification.rs (Notification::sticky()).
DECISION: reload-failure notification is sticky; every other notification auto-dismisses (T503).

tasks.title: Preserve stderr reload logs
tasks.description:
Mantenere `eprintln!`/log esistenti per debug e terminal visibility; toast è feedback user-facing, non replacement dei log.

---
**Completion summary:**
SHIPPED (no change needed beyond keeping them): reload_config's two stderr lines on the failure path are retained —
  eprintln!("[heca] reload failed: {e}");
  eprintln!("[heca] fix config.toml and press prefix+Shift+r to retry");
They fire alongside the new danger notification (T217), so a user watching the process in a terminal still sees the parse error even if they miss the toast. The success path prints nothing (unchanged).

VERIFICATION: present in heca/src/main.rs reload_config; both lint gates exit 0.
FILES: heca/src/main.rs.
